name: biz.sevana/voice-quality
title: Sevana Voice Quality
description: Voice quality analysis: PVQA and AQuA MOS for WAV files, VoIP call analysis for PCAPs

tools.name: aqua_compare
tools.description: Intrusive voice quality analysis (Sevana AQuA, wideband): compares a degraded/test WAV with its reference WAV and returns MOS, percent similarity and a fault analysis explaining the loss of quality. Upload both files first.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Start uploading a WAV recording (kind "wav") or a packet capture (kind "pcap"). Returns an upload_id and a one-time upload_url; send the file as the body of an HTTP PUT to that URL (for example: curl -T recording.wav '<upload_url>'), then pass the upload_id to an analysis tool. The URL works once and expires after 15 minutes; the file is deleted after an hour. Use upload_inline instead if you can only pass tool arguments.

filename.description: original file name, for display only

size_bytes.description: file size, if known; larger than the limit is refused at once

tools.name: delete_upload
tools.description: Delete an uploaded file now instead of waiting for it to expire.

upload_id.description: upload_id returned by create_upload or upload_inline

tools.name: job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running analysis job.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: State of an analysis job (queued, running with stage and percent, done, failed, cancelled). Waits up to wait_seconds for it to finish; a finished PCAP job includes its summary.

wait_seconds.description: wait up to this many seconds for the job to finish (0-55, default 0)

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Your analysis jobs from the last hour, newest first.

tools.name: pcap_analyze
tools.description: Start a VoIP quality analysis of an uploaded .pcap/.pcapng capture (upload it with kind "pcap"). Reconstructs SIP calls and RTP streams and scores every stream (Sevana MOS from the decoded speech, network MOS, loss, jitter). Returns a job_id; the call waits up to wait_seconds and, if the analysis finished by then, includes the summary. Otherwise poll job_status. Only analysis reports are returned, never decoded audio. Reports include SIP messages and DTMF digits as captured; they are kept for one hour.

statistics.description: compute aggregate statistics across streams (default true)

wait_seconds.description: wait up to this many seconds for the result (0-55, default 25)

tools.name: pcap_dtmf
tools.description: DTMF key presses found in a finished PCAP analysis, with digits and timing: RTP telephone-events (RFC 2833/4733) per stream and SIP INFO (application/dtmf-relay, application/dtmf).

tools.name: pcap_full_report
tools.description: The complete analysis report, one section at a time: "streams" or "sip_calls" (full objects, paged with cursor/limit) or "counters" (packet counters, SIP statistics, aggregate statistics). Contains no audio.

cursor.description: index of the first item (from next_cursor)

limit.description: items per page: streams default 5 (max 20), sip_calls default 3 (max 10); calls carry all their SIP messages

tools.name: pcap_get_call
tools.description: One SIP call of a finished PCAP analysis: peers, user agents, response codes, timing, the SIP message ladder (method or status line per message), health warnings and the call's streams.

call_id.description: SIP Call-ID, as listed by pcap_summary

tools.name: pcap_get_stream
tools.description: Full detail of one RTP stream: quality (Sevana and network MOS, R-factor, impairments, echo), loss gaps, payload types, DTMF events. include_timeline adds PVQA's per-interval (0.68 s) detector table.

stream_id.description: stream_id as listed by pcap_summary or pcap_get_call (valid only for this job)

include_timeline.description: add the per-interval PVQA detector table (large)

tools.name: pcap_network_stats
tools.description: Network view of a finished PCAP analysis: packet and SIP counters, per-stream loss, jitter, delay and network MOS, and the aggregate statistics (correlations of MOS with network features) when computed.

tools.name: pcap_sip_messages
tools.description: SIP messages of a finished PCAP analysis, exactly as captured (headers and SDP bodies), in time order. Filter by call_id; paged with cursor/limit.

cursor.description: index of the first message (from next_cursor)

tools.name: pcap_summary
tools.description: Overview of a finished PCAP analysis: packet totals, SIP calls with their health warnings, and streams ordered worst Sevana MOS first, each with codec, MOS, loss, jitter and impairments.

tools.name: pvqa_analyze
tools.description: Non-intrusive voice quality analysis (Sevana PVQA) of an uploaded WAV file: predicted MOS (1-5) and the impairments found (low SNR, noise, dead air, clipping, clicks, echo, packet-loss artifacts, ...). No reference recording is needed. report_type "extended" adds the per-interval detector table.

channel.description: channel to analyze, from 0 (default 0); -1 mixes all channels

tools.name: pvqa_detector
tools.description: Raw values of one PVQA detector over time for an uploaded WAV file. Detectors: SNR, DeadAir-00, DeadAir-01, Click, VADClip, AmpClip, DynClip, Echo, Noise, Crushed, DTMF.

detector.description: detector name: SNR, DeadAir-00, DeadAir-01, Click, VADClip, AmpClip, DynClip, Echo, Noise, Crushed or DTMF

tools.name: pvqa_timeline
tools.description: Impairment timeline of an uploaded WAV file: which impairments PVQA detects at which time.

resolution_ms.description: time step of the returned rows in ms (default 250, min 10); each row holds the maximum of every numeric column in its window. Coarsened automatically to stay within 1000 rows

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Analyzer versions, your tier (free or API key), your limits and how many analyses you have left.

tools.name: upload_inline
tools.description: Upload a WAV or pcap file as base64 in the tool arguments (2 MB at most after decoding). Returns an upload_id for the analysis tools. Larger files: use create_upload.

filename.description: original file name, for display only
